about: Natural Earth 1:110m polygons (public domain) from the potatoes-research corpus, with their exact convex skulls as published in the thesis. Generated by tools/make_fixture.py in the thesis parent repository.

fields.coords: the input polygon as given to the solvers (floats, exact)
fields.exact: the published Chang & Yap optimum, canonical: CCW, no collinear vertices, starting at the smallest vertex
fields.mesh_area, vertex_area, longest_segment_: the library's exact answers (mesh_area equals the published Aronov area)
fields.best_known: a certified body larger than the published optimum, for the seven optima the thesis shows suboptimal
